questions.question:
Select the number-pair in which the two numbers are related in the same way as are the two numbers of the following number-pair.

24 : 56
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

8 × 3 = 24; 8 × 7 = 56

Similarly,

3 × 3 = 9; 7 × 3 = 21

 

Hence, 9 : 21 is the correct answer.

questions.question: If HEAD is coded as 37 and BANK is coded as 57, then how will KITE be coded as?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23fb91535a3fd047def035ca10348dc61fa3389ce428cfdfb14993c2d4716480.png]

B + A + N + K = 2 + 1 + 14 + 11 = 28, **28 × 2 + 1 = 57**

Similarly

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

16, 24, 36, ?, 81
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

16 × 1.5 = 24

24 × 1.5 = 36

**36 × 1.5 = 54**

54 × 1.5 = 81

Hence, “54” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the number that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

**2ⁿd term + 3rd term = 1st term**

312 → 1 + 2 = 3

523 → 2 + 3 = 5

734 → 3 + 4 = 7

**953 → 5 + 3 = 8 ≠ 9**

Hence, “953” is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Logic: 1st term - 2nd term = 3rd term**

**Option 1) 953 → 9 - 5 = 4 ≠ 3**

Option 2) 312 → 3 - 1 = 2 

Option 3) 523 → 5 - 2 = 3

Option 4) 734 → 7 - 3 = 4

Hence, “953” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the gaps of the given letter series will complete the series.

ca_bab_ad_ab_ad_ab
questions.solution:
Repeating series is “c a d b a b “

Complete series will be:

c a **d** b a b **c** a d **b** a b **c** a d** b** a b

Hence, the correct answer is “d c b c b”

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

Some carpenters are technicians.

All technicians are mechanics.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some carpenters are mechanics.

II. Some mechanics are technicians.

III. All carpenters are mechanics.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e173074c035b539d3485bd94fd6e8f0583204bc23bbe5e0dd4ef744d832d938e.png] 

I. Some carpenters are mechanics → True

II. Some mechanics are technicians → True

III. All carpenters are mechanics → False (It is a case of possibility but not definitely true)

Hence, Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

24 - 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 11
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and -

24 + 12 ÷ 4 - 8 × 2 = 24 + 3 - 16

27 - 16 = 11

Interchanging + and ×

24-12div 4times 8+2=24-~(12times 8)/(4)+2

24 - 24 + 2 ≠ 11

Interchanging - and ÷

24 ÷ 12 - 4 + 8 × 2 = 2 - 4 + 16

-2 + 16 ≠ 11

Interchanging + and ÷

24-12+4~div 8times 2=12+~(4times 2)/(8)

12 + 1 ≠ 11

Hence, by interchanging + and - we get the correct equation.

questions.question: The average of 9 numbers is 40. If the average of the first five numbers is 38 and that of the last five is 50, then what is the fifth number?
questions.solution:
Total of 9 numbers = 9 × 40 = 360

Total of first 5 numbers = 5 × 38 = 190

Total of last 5 numbers = 5 × 50 = 250

Total of 10 numbers = 250 + 190 = 440

Now 5th term = 440 - 360 = 80.

Hence, 80 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Which number will be at the top if 5 is at the bottom?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6d9ab298ccbc977c2991f5cbc407561cb18de9172c3a1ded6d1b2b882f4ce05.png]
questions.solution:
In 1st cube we see that 1 and 3 are adjacent to 4.

In 2ⁿd cube we see that 2 and 6 are adjacent to 4.

Only remaining number 5 will be on opposite side of 4.

Hence, when 5 is at bottom 4 will be on top.

questions.question: ‘Geology’ is related to ‘Rocks’ in the same way as ‘Cytology’ is related to ‘__________’.
questions.solution:
Study of the Earth is called Geology.

And Earth is a rock.

Similarly,

Cytology is the study of Cells.

Hence, “cells” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd word out.
questions.solution:
Hinder, Arrest, and Impede all have similar meanings, all referring to obstructing or slowing down a process or action.

"Steal", on the other hand, refers to taking something that belongs to someone else without permission, which is different from the concept of obstruction or delay.

Hence, Steal is odd among them.
